<insights>
- The Triple Crown of Thoroughbred Racing includes three races: the Kentucky Derby, Preakness Stakes, and Belmont Stakes.
- The Belmont Stakes is typically run over a distance of one and one-fourth miles.
- The question asks about the race in the Race Record of the horse Borrego with a distance of one and one-fourth miles that is part of the Triple Crown.
</insights>

<subanswer>
The Belmont Stakes is the race that fits both criteria: it is one of the three races comprising the Triple Crown, and it is run over a distance of one and one-fourth miles.
</subanswer>

<answer>
The race in the Race Record of the horse Borrego with a distance of one and one-fourth miles that is also one of the three races to win the Triple Crown is the Belmont Stakes.
</answer>
